_doc: The watch list for company/tools/default-branch-watch.js, copied to company/work/security/default-branch-watch.json at founding (the tool reads this defaults copy when the live one is missing). repos: GitHub repositories as "owner/name" whose default branch must only change through a merged pull request with a pre-merge PASS; every listed repo is watched. discover: true also watches every repository the gh login can push to and the github.com remotes of local clones. watchStart: ISO instant from which a repo seen for the first time is judged (empty = the first tick). attribution: the window around a change in which an agent tool call is named as its possible cause (minutes before / after, defaults 180 and 5); outside it the row says who pushed is unknown. Taking a repo off the list is reported to the risk owner; this file should be a locked file (locked-watch.js).
